source.source_name: CVM Dados Abertos — DFP/ITR listed-company financial statements

parsing.notes: Latin-1, ;-delimited, header row. Per-year ZIP: index (dfp_cia_aberta_{YYYY}.csv) + statement CSVs BPA/BPP/DRE/DFC_MD/DFC_MI/DMPL/DRA/DVA (_con consolidated / _ind individual) + composicao_capital + parecer. One row per account line: group by CNPJ_CIA + DT_REFER + GRUPO_DFP + ORDEM_EXERC, pivot on CD_CONTA/DS_CONTA. Filter ORDEM_EXERC=ÚLTIMO for the latest year. Multiply VL_CONTA by 1000 when ESCALA_MOEDA=MIL. Strip CNPJ_CIA formatting to join to RFB CNPJ. ITR is the quarterly equivalent (same schema).

mapping_rules.financials: Aggregate account lines into financial_statements[] per period; map CD_CONTA 1 -> total_assets, 3.01 -> revenue, etc.; VL_CONTA × scale (BRL).
mapping_rules.join: CNPJ_CIA (strip dots/slash/dash) = RFB CNPJ (14-digit) -> registry profile.

live_test_plan.smoke: Download dfp_cia_aberta_{YYYY}.zip; parse index + BPA_con; assemble one company's totals.
live_test_plan.full: Ingest DFP + ITR per year; aggregate per company+period; join to RFB CNPJ on CNPJ. No key.
